en.t: The man clenched her toes in his hand.

units.source_text: 那脚趾宛如冰冷的蛞蝓，潮乎乎地粘在他的掌心里。

en.t: Those toes were like cold slugs, damp and sticky against his palm.

units.source_text: 阿笑的肌肤白得近似白蜗牛肉。

en.t: A Sho's skin was so white it was almost like the flesh of a white snail.

units.source_text: 她把脚趾全交给男人之后，就活像一块厚脂肪，无拘无束地倒在男人身上。

en.t: After she had yielded all her toes to the man, she collapsed freely against him, just like a thick lump of fat.
